approvalMessage.text:
APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 59 Chapter 733
 
       MEMORANDUM filed with Assembly Bill Number 219-A, entitled:
 
    "AN  ACT to amend the education law, in relation to requiring licen-
        sure of athletic trainers; and to amend the social services law,
        in relation to making athletic trainers mandatory  reporters  of
        suspected child abuse or maltreatment"
 
    APPROVED
 
  This bill would establish licensure requirements for athletic trainers
in  New York, including new qualification requirements and updated scope
of practice, and make licensed athletic trainers mandated  reporters  of
suspected child abuse.
 
  However,  certain  technical changes were necessary to ensure licensed
athletic trainers can continue to  treat  concussions  and  neurological
injuries that occur on the field.
 
  I have reached an agreement with the Legislature to enact these chang-
es.  On the basis of this agreement, I am pleased to sign this bill.
 
  This bill is approved.                         (signed) KATHY HOCHUL
 
                                ______

summary: Relates to the licensure of athletic trainers; adds athletic trainers to the list of persons and officials required to report cases of suspected child abuse or maltreatment.
